title: Eleven Bats and One Valley
subtitle: 科学探索 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）
meta: 主题语境：科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）　|　核心词汇：research　|　正文 306 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 research 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: For eleven years my aunt did ① research into the bats of one valley, and for eleven years the count went down, which she wrote every autumn in the same notebook with the same care. She said ② research is not the answer but the repeating; anybody can count once, and the research is the repeating, not the result. The ③ research she is known for now, the thing named after her, is a three-page note from 1974 that nobody wanted to publish.

She began as a ④ research student in 1968, sent out with a tape recorder and no supervisor worth the name, and she finished as the person other people telephoned. What she never did was ⑤ publish the research early: she said a result you have not repeated is an opinion with a number after it.

In 1981 she ⑥ carried out research for the county into why the bats were going, and reported that the answer was the river, the farming and the streetlights, in that order. The ⑦ research ran to four pages, was filed, and nothing was done about it for nine years. The county's own copy, when I asked for it in 2015, had gone.

By 1990 there were eleven bats left and she was doing ⑧ research nobody had asked for, on a grant nobody could find, and she said it was the best year of her working life because the research was hers alone.

In 1996 a journalist came to write about her and had done ⑨ no research at all, and she threw him out. The ⑩ research findings she had sent in six years earlier — eleven bats, one valley, forty-one pages — are the reason the valley is now a reserve. She died in 2003 and I have her notebooks, which are full of the word and of the same number written eleven times.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 研究；调查（总称，不可数）
B. n.[U] 研究工作；研究活动
C. n. 研究成果；成名的研究（the research she is known for）
D. 固定搭配：do / carry out research 进行／开展研究
E. 固定搭配：research into / on sth. 关于……的研究
F. 固定搭配：research findings 研究结果；研究发现
G. n. 查证；资料搜集（do no research）
H. n. 研究生；研究用的（a research student）

items.q: did research into the bats of one valley
She said research is not the answer
The research she is known for now
She began as a research student in 1968
she carried out research for the county
The research ran to four pages
she was doing research nobody had asked for
had done no research at all
The research findings she had sent in six years earlier

answers.why: research into sth. 意为“关于……的研究”，她对同一个山谷的蝙蝠做了十一年研究。
research 意为“研究工作”，她说研究不是答案而是重复本身。
the research she is known for 意为“使她成名的研究成果”，即 1974 年那三页笔记。
a research student 意为“研究生”，她 1968 年从研究生做起。
publish the research 意为“发表这项研究”，她从不提早发表。
carry out research 意为“开展研究”，1981 年她为县里做了一项研究。
the research 指“那份研究（报告）”，它只有四页，被归档了。
doing research 意为“做研究工作”，1990 年她在做没人要求她做的研究。
do no research 意为“不做查证、不搜集资料”，那个记者一点功课都没做。
research findings 意为“研究结果、研究发现”，她六年前提交的那份结果使山谷成了保护区。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 我姑妈对一个山谷里的蝙蝠做了十一年研究。（research into）
她说，研究不是答案，而是重复。（research）
她 1968 年从一名研究生做起。（a research student）
她从不提早发表研究成果。（publish the research）
1981 年她为县里开展了一项研究。（carry out research）
那位记者一点查证的功课都没做。（do no research）
answers: My aunt did research into the bats of one valley for eleven years.
She said research is not the answer but the repeating.
She began as a research student in 1968.
She never published the research early.
In 1981 she carried out research for the county.
The journalist had done no research at all.
